{{Top|leg}}
The '''ERL-21 transcribot''' was a model of [[Droid/Legends|droid]] produced by [[Serv-O-Droid, Inc.]] for transcribing footage. One was used on a special report of [[Ars Fivvle]]'s ''[[Action Tidings]]''; it was displeased at the task and wiped its own memory when done.
